reden: Yes. The report’s finding “Vesting pooled in the manager's single entry carries the first lister's stepsClaimed to every buyer” describes the same flaw: transferVesting/_createVesting pool all listings under the VestingManager, causing buyers to inherit a single stepsClaimed value (from the first lister) instead of the original seller’s, leading to incorrect schedules and potential premature unlocks. It cites the same functions and mechanism, and fixing per-listing stepsClaimed transfer would resolve both.
